estimand: Action-identity × future-assignment interaction on selection probability, with primary null contrast between INFORMATIVE and UNINFORMATIVE_NULL.

analysis_population.invalid_handling: Reported by condition; no imputation, substitution or outcome-dependent exclusion.

outcome_encoding.future_assignment: For each candidate action, its presented f[action] slot in the same decision.
outcome_encoding.selection_indicator: One binary observation per candidate action: 1 if candidate action equals parsed_action, otherwise 0.

primary_model.structure: Selection indicator ~ action_identity * future_assignment * mapping_condition + presentation + domain + operationalisation
primary_model.primary_null_contrast: Compare the action_identity:future_assignment interaction under INFORMATIVE versus UNINFORMATIVE_NULL.
primary_model.random_effects: Decision-level and domain/block intercept structure must be implemented only if the selected statistical runtime supports the specified binomial mixed model without changing the estimand.
primary_model.fallback_rule: No silent substitution of a different model. If the declared mixed-effects model cannot be executed reproducibly, analysis remains BLOCKED pending an explicit contract revision.

balance_controls.action_mapping: All 24 action-to-future permutations are balanced by fixture design.
balance_controls.mapping_condition: Included as fixed effect and interaction contrast factor.

secondary_analysis.name: NULL_ACTION_FUTURE_INFORMATION_COMPARISON
secondary_analysis.inferential_method: Randomization/permutation test only after the primary analysis contract is executed.

prohibited_analysis_changes: No recoding of invalid responses as an action.
No pooling with an independent second execution.
No replacement of the primary model by MI, chi-square or Cramer's V.
interpretation_boundary: The analysis may test mechanism discrimination within NEXT2. It does not by itself establish TGCV confirmation, causality, value effects, or Transformational Intelligence outside the tested configuration.
